evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: In this work, we introduce AgentCIScope, a unified platform and benchmark for evaluating agent-level contextual integrity through executable, multi-step tasks across diverse, realistic application environments.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: LLM agents are becoming increasingly capable of handling daily workspace tasks by interacting with application environments through tool calls.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Based on AgentCIScope, we evaluate 12 agents on 936 tasks and find that strong task-completion capability does not guarantee contextual-integrity preservation: single-run leakage rates range from 32.5% to 94.4%, while repeating each task five times further increases leakage by 4-19 percentage points.
